raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview



Use per-token dynamic FP8 activation quantization instead of per-tensor quantization.
- for better performance
- for better compatablity with xpu graph (during graph execution, padding can cause per-tensor quantization to capture uninitailized values (nan/inf) via `max` op, causing the acc issues. per-token quantization can avoid this issue.）

## Claims



## Validation


`VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=XPUW8A16FP8LinearKernel python3 examples/basic/offline_inference/generate.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --max-model-len 4096 -tp 1 --quantization fp8`

## Details

```
lm_eval --model local-chat-completions --task gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 1 --model_args "model=Qwen/Qwen3-8B,base_url=http://loca
lhost:8111/v1/chat/completions,max_gen_toks=4096,num_concurrent=64,timeout=5000,max_retries=5" --apply_chat_template --output_path ./lm_eval_output --log_samples

```

files.patch:
@@ -274,7 +274,7 @@ def __init__(self, quant_config: Fp8Config):
             # Use per-token quantization for better perf if dynamic and cutlass
             if self.act_q_static:
                 self.activation_quant_key = kFp8StaticTensorSym
-            elif cutlass_fp8_supported():
+            elif cutlass_fp8_supported() or current_platform.is_xpu():
                 self.activation_quant_key = kFp8DynamicTokenSym
             else:
                 self.activation_quant_key = kFp8DynamicTensorSym

@@ -190,7 +190,9 @@ class Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod(OnlineLinearBase):
     Loads fp16/bf16 weights and quantizes them per-tensor during loading."""
 
     activation_quant_key = (
-        kFp8DynamicTokenSym if cutlass_fp8_supported() else kFp8DynamicTensorSym
+        kFp8DynamicTokenSym
+        if cutlass_fp8_supported() or current_platform.is_xpu()
+        else kFp8DynamicTensorSym
     )
 
     def __init__(self):
